blockers: Each company needs a historical continuous listing/security-identity interval or an explicit censoring event. Index additions are dated event evidence only.
Issuer press-release pagination and complete 8-K/6-K/tender/merger/termination filings must be enumerated across the entire twelve-month window.
Date-only publication evidence must retain uncertainty; no midnight event timestamps or invented provider hashes.
A full historical universe requires a baseline plus all changes, including intra-year removals; annual reconstitution deltas alone are incomplete.
Independent label review and point-in-time feature availability remain separate gates.

candidate_ledger_lineage.use: Legal-name/CIK identity links only, never evidence of listing or a negative outcome.

scope: 20 distinct named additions from the exchange 2020 NBI reconstitution; partial historical event population, not current survivors or annual SEC filing proxies.
